title: Guest visibility census cannot establish Account readiness
user_impact: Guest role visibility remains unverified because the test census stopped before positive role proof and complete control accounting. No public product behavior failure is established.
reported_by: Native guest visibility census receipt on 2026-10-07
preconditions: Use the existing standalone public development fixture and existing hosted workflow inputs; retain current-run frozen development run/artifact IDs.
Use a fresh disposable guest profile under the existing resource guards and require positive role proof before interpreting visibility.
reproduction: Run .github/workflows/hosted-guest-acceptance.yml with acceptance_case=visibility-census-guest and the current-run frozen development_run_id=37619740064 and development_artifact_id=11482071536.

Inspect only the exact run receipt and safe census diagnostics. Require positive signed-out guest-state proof and complete accounting of all controls/regions; preserve unknown, unsupported, inaccessible, or gated regions as incomplete.

In run 37621192492, observe the terminal assertion census_guest_account_ready_not_observed before census completion. The diagnostic records two Account candidates with safe_to_open=false, 15 candidates total (12 mapped, 3 fingerprint-only), and no inaccessible-region count because the assertion stopped completeness accounting.
expected: The exact guest artifact and run establish positive guest-role proof, safely identify readiness, and account for every inventoried control and region. Unknown, unsupported, gated, or unaccounted regions leave the census incomplete.
actual: Run 37621192492 failed at census_guest_account_ready_not_observed. The census did not complete, did not visit all controls, and did not observe positive signed-out guest state. Two Account candidates were unsafe to open; the diagnostic included 15 candidates, 12 mapped and 3 fingerprint-only. No action controls were clicked. This is a native census/readiness failure only; no public product behavior failure or member/admin result is established.
cause: Unconfirmed pending actual UI review of the captured screenshots in hosted result artifact 11481804368. Do not infer why the Account candidates were unsafe to open.
